Coherent 32QAM Optical Communication System with JAX High-Speed ​​DSP Engine

32QAM has a very special "Cross" constellation diagram. To cope with its dense decision boundaries, this tutorial deals with up to 131,072 symbols. We will use a handwritten JAX Decision-Guided Equalizer (DD-LMS) and Decision-Guided Phase-Locked Loop (DD-PLL) instead of traditional blind algorithms.
